title: Platform and automation engineering
lede: I work across the boundary between infrastructure and product: pipelines that deploy, clusters that are run, controls that are operated, and tooling built so the team ships faster.
body: My most recent work is DevOps on a software platform of Java and Spring Cloud microservices running on Kubernetes and OpenShift, with Oracle and PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Kafka, IBM MQ and SQS. There I own the CI/CD pipelines, the pre-production clusters, cloud provisioning, and the security controls.

Before that I built microservices and integration platforms for banking and telecoms, and led compliance projects as a technical lead. Since 2023 I have been setting the technical direction for mobile delivery in React Native, using an agentic delivery method: an executable delivery contract, TDD, and release gates.
